raw.title: Hyperscaler Earnings Previews: Alphabet, Microsoft And Amazon - Maybe The Bearish Sentiment Will Help
raw.text: The name of the game for investors around mega-cap tech seems to be evolving to be less about the typical revenue, EPS and operating income growth, and earnings and revenue guidance, and more about sector capital, free cash flow and capex growth, debt issuance and the ability to raise capital, as well as the longer-term prospects for a firm's credit standing. With capex determining free cash flow around the AI-related stocks, and free cash flow being the primary valuation component (at least in terms of the discounted cash flow model), the science of valuation has become the art of valuation. Microsoft seems to be the safer bet coming into these September quarter earnings, but outsized capex guidance, particularly for calendar 2027 if companies should choose to give it, will be the defining metric. The greater the upside to capex, the lower the forward estimates to free cash flow.

raw.title: Hyperscaler Earnings Previews: Alphabet, Microsoft And Amazon - Maybe The Bearish Sentiment Will Help
raw.text: The name of the game for investors around mega-cap tech seems to be evolving to be less about the typical revenue, EPS and operating income growth, and earnings and revenue guidance, and more about sector capital, free cash flow and capex growth, debt issuance and the ability to raise capital, as well as the longer-term prospects for a firm's credit standing. With capex determining free cash flow around the AI-related stocks, and free cash flow being the primary valuation component (at least in terms of the discounted cash flow model), the science of valuation has become the art of valuation. Microsoft seems to be the safer bet coming into these September quarter earnings, but outsized capex guidance, particularly for calendar 2027 if companies should choose to give it, will be the defining metric. The greater the upside to capex, the lower the forward estimates to free cash flow.

raw.title: SPACCircle Acquisition Corp. Announces the Pricing of $100 Million Initial Public Offering
raw.text: SACRAMENTO, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SPACCircle Acquisition Corp. (the “Company”) announced the pricing of its initial public offering of 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit. The units will be listed on the Nasdaq Global Market (“Nasdaq”) under the symbol “SCQCU” commencing today. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share of the Company, one redeemable warrant, entitling the holder thereof to purchase one Class A ordinary share of the Company at an exercise price of $11.50 per share and one right to receive one half (1/2) of one Class A ordinary share upon the consummation of an initial business combination. Once the securities comprising the units begin separate trading, the Company expects that the Class A ordinary shares, warrants and rights will be listed on Nasdaq under the symbols “SCQC,” “SCQCW” and “SCQCR” respectively. The offering is expected to close on October 28, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.

raw.text: NEW YORK, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Nasdaq, Inc. (Nasdaq: NDAQ) today announced the appointment of Börje Ekholm to its Board of Directors. Ekholm is the former President and CEO of Ericsson, the former President and CEO of Investor AB, and a previous Chair of the Nasdaq Board of Directors. Ekholm's appointment is effective as of November 1, 2026, and he will serve as a member of the Audit & Risk Committee. Separately, Nasdaq today announced that Holden Spaht has notified Nasdaq of his decision to resign from the Board, effective December 31, 2026.

raw.text: WALTHAM, Mass., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Repligen Corporation (NASDAQ:RGEN) (“Repligen”), today announced that it entered into privately negotiated exchange and/or subscription agreements with certain holders of its outstanding 1.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 (the “2028 Notes”) and certain new investors, pursuant to which Repligen will issue $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of 0.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 (the “New Notes”). Approximately $541.4 million principal amount of the New Notes will be issued in exchange for approximately $456.8 million principal amount of 2028 Notes (the “Exchange Transactions”) and approximately $458.6 million principal amount of the New Notes will be issued for cash (the “Subscription Transactions”, and together with the Exchange Transactions, the “Transactions”). The conversion price for the New Notes will initially be approximately $226.37 per share of Repligen's common stock, which represents a conversion premium of approximately 20% over the closing price of Repligen's common stock on October 29, 2026, subject to customary anti-dilution adjustments. Following the closing of the Transactions, which is expected to occur on or about November 6, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions, approximately $143.2 million in aggregate principal amount of 2028 Notes will remain outstanding with terms unchanged.

raw.title: Denali Therapeutics Receives 2026 Prix Galien USA Award for AVLAYAH® (tividenofusp alfa-eknm) as Best Biotechnology Product
raw.text: SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Denali Therapeutics Inc. (Nasdaq: DNLI) today announced that AVLAYAH® (tividenofusp alfa-eknm) has been recognized as the “Best Biotechnology Product” of 2026 by The Galien Foundation. AVLAYAH is the first biologic approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) that is specifically designed to cross the blood-brain barrier and reach the whole body, including the brain. AVLAYAH is an enzyme replacement therapy that received FDA accelerated approval in March 2026 for the treatment of neurologic manifestations of a rare neurodegenerative disease called Hunter syndrome (mucopolysaccharidosis type II, or MPS II) when initiated in presymptomatic or symptomatic pediatric patients weighing at least 5 kg prior to advanced neurologic impairment. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification of clinical benefit in a confirmatory study.

raw.text: Denver, Colorado, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Recursion (Nasdaq: RXRX), a leading clinical-stage company pioneering AI-enabled drug discovery and development, today announced new positive Phase 2 data from the ongoing TUPELO trial of REC-4881, an investigational, oral MEK1/2 inhibitor for familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP). The new analyses show that most patients had reductions in both the number of larger, higher-risk polyps and in lower GI polyp burden, building on the upper GI results announced on October 15, 2026. raw.title: Rapport Announces Closing of Public Offerings of Common Stock and Pre-Funded Warrants and Convertible Notes, Including Full Exercise of Underwriters' Options to Purchase Additional Shares and Notes, as well as Concurrent Private Placement
raw.text: BOSTON and SAN DIEGO, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rapport Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: RAPP) (“Rapport” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to the discovery and development of small molecule precision medicines for patients with neurological or psychiatric disorders, today announced the closing of its previously announced separate underwritten public offerings of 9,761,905 shares of its common stock, which includes the exercise in full of the underwriters' option to purchase up to 1,428,571 additional shares of its common stock, at a public offering price of $21.00 per share (the “Offering Price”) and, in lieu of common stock to investors that so choose, pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 1,190,476 shares of its common stock at an offering price of $20.999 per pre-funded warrant, which represents the per share Offering Price less the $0.001 per share exercise price for each pre-funded warrant (the “common stock offering”) and $172.5 million aggregate principal amount of 2.25% convertible senior notes due 2032 (the “notes”), which includes the exercise in full of the underwriters' over-allotment option to purchase up to an additional $22.5 million aggregate principal amount of notes (the “notes offering” and together with the common stock offering, the “underwritten offerings”). Concurrently with the underwritten offerings, Rapport entered into a securities purchase agreement with a certain investor (the “Investor”), in a separately negotiated transaction (the “concurrent private placement” and together with the underwritten offerings, the “offerings”) pursuant to which Rapport sold to the Investor 1,428,571 shares of Rapport's common stock, at the Offering Price.

raw.title: Rapport Announces Pricing of Underwritten Offerings of Common Stock and Pre-Funded Warrants and Convertible Notes and Concurrent Private Placement
raw.text: BOSTON and SAN DIEGO, Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rapport Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: RAPP) (“Rapport” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to the discovery and development of small molecule precision medicines for patients with neurological or psychiatric disorders, today announced the pricing of separate underwritten public offerings of approximately $175.0 million of shares of its common stock at an offering price of $21.00 per share (the “Offering Price”) and, in lieu of common stock to investors that so choose, pre-funded warrants to purchase up to approximately $25.0 million of shares of its common stock at an offering price of $20.999 per pre-funded warrant, which represents the per share Offering Price less the $0.001 per share exercise price for each pre-funded warrant (the “common stock offering”) and $150.0 million aggregate principal amount of 2.25% convertible senior notes due 2032 (the “notes”) (the “notes offering” and together with the common stock offering, the “underwritten offerings”). Concurrently with the underwritten offerings, Rapport entered into a share purchase agreement with a certain investor (the “Investor”), in a separately negotiated transaction (the “concurrent private placement” and together with the underwritten offerings, the “offerings”) pursuant to which Rapport agreed to offer and sell, and the Investor agreed to purchase, approximately $30.0 million of shares of Rapport's common stock, at the Offering Price. The sale of shares to the Investor in the concurrent private placement will not be registered as part of the common stock offering.

raw.title: Rapport Announces Proposed Public Offerings of Common Stock and Convertible Notes as well as Concurrent Private Placement
raw.text: BOSTON and SAN DIEGO, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rapport Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: RAPP) (“Rapport” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to the discovery and development of small molecule precision medicines for patients with neurological or psychiatric disorders, today announced that it has commenced separate underwritten public offerings of $200.0 million of shares of its common stock (the “common stock offering”) and $150.0 million aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2032 (the “notes offering” and together with the common stock offering, the “underwritten offerings”). In addition, Rapport intends to grant the underwriters in the common stock offering a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $30.0 million of shares of its common stock under the same terms and conditions and intends to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $22.5 million aggregate principal amount of notes solely to cover over-allotments, if any. Concurrently with the underwritten offerings, Rapport intends to enter into a share purchase agreement with a certain investor named therein (the “Investor”), in a separately negotiated transaction (the “concurrent private placement” and together with the underwritten offerings, the “offerings”) pursuant to which Rapport intends to offer and sell, and the Investor intends to purchase shares of Rapport's common stock at the price per share of common stock in the common stock offering. The sale of shares to the Investor in the proposed concurrent private placement will not be registered as part of the common stock offering. The proposed offerings are subject to market and other conditions, and there can be no assurance as to whether or when the offerings may be completed, or as to the actual size or terms of the offerings.

raw.text: Five Star Bancorp NASDAQ: FSBC reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $21.9 million, up from $19.4 million in the second quarter, as loan growth, a higher net interest margin and improved operating efficiency supported results. raw.title: Ballard launches HPU Agile-H: 80kW of clean power in a lightweight, towable unit
raw.text: Designed by GeoPura, manufactured by Siemens Energy and powered by a Ballard fuel cell, HPU Agile-H is available to pre-order now for delivery in Q1 2027 HPU Agile-H VANCOUVER, BC and NEWCASTLE, United Kingdom, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ballard Power Systems (NASDAQ: BLDP) (TSX: BLDP), through its recent acquisition, GeoPura, has launched the HPU Agile-H, a lightweight, towable Hydrogen Power Unit (HPU) developed in response to customer demand for smaller, more flexible clean power. raw.text: New York, NY, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Chaince Securities, LLC (“Chaince”), a FINRA-registered broker-dealer and wholly owned subsidiary of Chaince Digital Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: CD), today announced that it has been engaged as the exclusive sales agent for the at-the-market (“ATM”) equity offering program of Solowin Holdings (NASDAQ: AXG) (the “Company”), a Cayman Islands-incorporated holding company headquartered in Hong Kong whose operations are conducted through its operating subsidiaries and whose offerings span regulated stablecoin issuance and payments, asset tokenization, securities trading and asset management, and AI-powered enterprise services. raw.text: LEXINGTON, Mass., Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Voyager Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: VYGR), a biotechnology company dedicated to leveraging genetics to treat neurological diseases, today announced two poster presentations at the upcoming 19th Clinical Trials on Alzheimer's Disease (CTAD) Conference taking place in Boston, November 16-19, 2026. raw.title: Timberland Bancorp 2026 Fiscal Year's Net Income Increases 7% to $31.2 Million
raw.text: HOQUIAM, Wash., Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Timberland Bancorp, Inc. (“Anteris” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: AVR, ASX: AVR) a global healthcare company committed to designing, developing, and commercializing cutting-edge medical devices to restore healthy heart function, today announced 30-day clinical and hemodynamic outcomes for the Medium-size DurAVR® Transcatheter Heart Valve (THV) in twenty-two severe aortic stenosis patients with medium aortic annuli (aortic annulus area 492 ± 38 mm2). raw.title: Tibooburra Project Update: RC drilling to commence as Novo forms unincorporated Joint Venture with Manhattan Gold
raw.text: HIGHLIGHTS Novo has now received all regulatory and land holder approvals required to commence a ~2,700 m RC program at Tibooburra, NSW, with drilling at the Clone prospect currently anticipated to commence in early-November 2026.  Step out drilling at the Clone prospect will target a northern extension to open, shallowly plunging, high-grade gold mineralisation confirmed during Novo's 2025 drill campaign that reported results up to 12 m @ 5.90 g/t Au from 16 m, including 5 m @ 13.74 g/t Au from 23 m in TBR0001.1   Regional streams and targeted soils, mapping and rock chip sampling commenced at Tibooburra in September 2026, with results pending and a further program being undertaken in October 2026.

The stock options were granted under the Zentalis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 2022 Employment Inducement Incentive Award Plan (2022 Inducement Plan) as an inducement material to each such individual's entering into employment with Zentalis in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

raw.title: Kazia Therapeutics Announces Two Abstracts on Paxalisib Tumor and Immune Reprogramming Research Accepted for Poster Presentation at 2026 San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium
raw.text: Presentations to Explore Paxalisib's Differentiated Tumor and Immune Reprogramming Activity SYDNEY, Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kazia Therapeutics Limited (NASDAQ: KZIA) ("Kazia" or the "Company"), an oncology-focused biotechnology company developing therapies that selectively reprogram cancer biology, restore anti-tumor immunity and overcome treatment resistance, today announced that two abstracts highlighting new preclinical and translational research on paxalisib's differentiated biological activity and potential application across breast cancer settings have been accepted for poster presentation at this year's San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium ("SABCS"), taking place on Dec. 8 through 11, 2026, in San Antonio, Texas. The presentations will explore two complementary areas of research: the distinct tumor and immune reprogramming effects of paxalisib compared with other dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitors in preclinical models, and its potential to suppress local recurrence and metastatic progression when administered following standard neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy in a preclinical model of stage III triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC): Poster 1 (P4-9-18): "Paxalisib uniquely induces durable tumour and immune reprogramming across breast cancer subtypes, challenging the paradigm that dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitors are biologically equivalent" Poster 2 (P4-10-26): "Suppression of Local and Metastatic Recurrence by Adjuvant PI3K/mTOR Inhibition Through Durable Immune Epigenetic Rewiring Following Neoadjuvant Chemo-Immunotherapy in Stage III Triple-Negative Breast Cancer" The research further explores paxalisib's differentiated ability to reprogram tumor and immune biology in preclinical models, suggesting that these effects are not necessarily shared by other dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitors.

raw.text: Aoxiangyu 819, Aoyu 966, and Aoyu 288 delivered yield gains of 6.0% to 8.6% over control varieties in two-year national regional trials; 30-day public notice period runs through November 22, 2026 BEIJING, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Origin Agritech Limited (NASDAQ: SEED) ("Origin" or the "Company"), a leading Chinese agricultural technology company, today announced that three of its corn varieties, Aoxiangyu 819, Aoyu 966, and Aoyu 288, have passed the preliminary review of the 13th Session of the Fifth National Crop Variety Approval Committee of China. recentNews.title: Two Leading Labs Confirm RHB-204 MAP-Killing Effect for RedHill's Crohn's Disease Candidate

raw.title: Two Leading Labs Confirm RHB-204 MAP-Killing Effect for RedHill's Crohn's Disease Candidate
raw.text: In vitro studies, undertaken by two leading microbiology centers, confirm RHB-204's killing capability on Mycobacterium avium subspecies paratuberculosis (MAP) and its MAP-killing comparability to RedHill's RHB-104 in both long-term intracellular culture and spot and phage assays The two sets of studies, showing confirmed MAP-killing effect and comparability to RHB-104, led by Professor Tim Bull from City St George's University of London, and Prof Irene Grant, Professor of Microbiology and Food Safety, Queen's University Belfast and Dr Hannah Dane, further support development of RHB-204's potential in MAP-related Crohn's disease  In its positive Phase 3 study, RHB-104 met the primary endpoint with statistical significance, showing RHB-104 plus standard of care (SoC) to be 64% more effective than SoC alone in treating Crohn's disease, compared to the placebo (standard of care only) group (p = 0.0048) 1  RHB-204 2 , a proprietary next-generation oral optimized formulation of RHB-104 3 , designed for reduced toxicity and side effects and enhanced patient adherence, employs a differentiated, MAP-targeted approach to the treatment of Crohn's disease  RALEIGH, N.C. and TEL AVIV, Israel, Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- RedHill Biopharma Ltd.

raw.title: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals Announces Partnership with The University of Southern Mississippi to Evaluate Castanospermine in Nonclinical Models of Alpha-Gal Syndrome
raw.text: WASHINGTON, Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: SXTP; SXTPW) (the “Company”), a pharmaceutical company focused on developing new medicines for vector-borne diseases, today announced expansion of its vector-borne disease research portfolio through a sponsored research agreement with The University of Southern Mississippi (USM) to assess the therapeutic potential of castanospermine—a naturally occurring iminosugar derived from the Australian Chestnut (Castanospermum australe)—in nonclinical models of alpha-gal syndrome (AGS). The partnership leverages USM's established vector biology research expertise and investigator insights into tick-borne disease.

raw.title: AbbVie Submits Biologics License Application (BLA) for Etentamig to U.S. FDA for Adults Living With Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma
raw.text: –  Etentamig is a second-generation BCMA-directed bispecific antibody T-cell engager with a clinical profile and dosing schedule that can potentially support treatment across a broad range of settings, including in community-based care –  In the Phase 3 CERVINO study, etentamig achieved statistically significant improvements in overall response rate (ORR) and progression-free survival (PFS) versus investigator's choice of standard available therapies –  Submission underscores AbbVie's ambition to advance a broad multiple myeloma portfolio that addresses disease complexity and supports patients' evolving care goals  NORTH CHICAGO, Ill., Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) today announced the submission of a Biologics License Application (BLA) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for etentamig, a second-generation BCMA x CD3 bispecific antibody T-cell engager administered intravenously for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.1 BCMA-directed bispecific antibodies and CAR-T therapies have significantly changed the treatment landscape for people living with multiple myeloma.2 However, their broader adoption may be limited by adverse events such as cytokine release syndrome, infections or neurotoxicity, as well as specialized administration and monitoring requirements.2,3,4 Additionally, as disease relapses, treatment options in later lines of therapy become increasingly limited.

raw.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP, Girard Sharp LLP, and The Hall Firm, Ltd., all national law firms specializing in complex class actions and shareholder rights, announce they have filed a class action lawsuit for violations of the federal securities laws against Compass, Inc. (“Compass” or “Company”) (NYSE: COMP) and certain officers and directors of Compass and Anywhere Real Estate Inc. (“Anywhere”). The class action asserts claims under Sections 11, 12(a)(2), and 15 of the Securities Act of 1933 on behalf of former Anywhere shareholders who acquired newly issued Compass common stock in direct exchange for their Anywhere securities in the January 9, 2026 stock-for-stock transaction (the “Merger”) by which Compass merged with and acquired Anywhere (the “Class”). The case is pending in the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York and is captioned: Magloire v. Compass, Inc., et al., No. 1:26-cv-08885 (S.D.N.Y.).

raw.text: Viking Therapeutics, Inc. is advancing VK2735, a dual GLP-1/GIP agonist, targeting the obesity and diabetes market dominated by Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk. raw.title: Donald Rare Earth and Mineral Sands Project Achieves Major Government Financing Milestone
raw.text: Energy Fuels' first large-scale source of rare earth minerals advances toward a final investment decision following receipt of conditional credit approval from Export Finance Australia and the Australian National Reconstruction Fund Corporation for up to A$180 million, as part of a proposed A$200 million senior project finance debt facility DENVER, Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE American: UUUU) (TSX: EFR) (ASX: EF2), a leading U.S.-based producer of rare earth elements ("REE"), uranium, and other critical materials, today announced that Export Finance Australia ("EFA") and the National Reconstruction Fund Corporation ("NRFC"), two major Australian Government financing institutions, have together conditionally approved a commitment for up to A$180 million (US$126 million), as part of a proposed A$200 million senior project finance debt facility, to support construction of Phase 1 of the Donald Rare Earth and Mineral Sands Project in Australia (the "Donald Project"). Completion of the EFA and NRFC financings is subject to entry of definitive documentation and project documentation, satisfactory completion of due diligence, the balance of the required debt funding provided by commercial lenders and final approvals.

raw.title: AEON STRATEGIES LTD. Provides Update on Anticipated Late Filing of Annual Financial Statements
raw.text: TORONTO, ONTARIO – TheNewswire - October 27, 2026 — AEON STRATEGIES LTD. (formerly Cloud3 Ventures Inc.) (CSE: AEON) (OTCQB: CLDVF) (FSE: WQ40) (the “ Company ” or “ Aeon ”) provides an update to its news release dated October 23, 2026 (the “ Default Announcement ”) regarding the anticipated late filing of its audited annual financial statements for the year ended June 30, 2026, the related management's discussion and analysis and the related CEO and CFO certifications (collectively, the “ Annual Filings ”). The Default Announcement stated that the Company expected to file the Annual Filings on or before December 4, 2026. The Company's auditor, Davidson & Company LLP (the “ Auditor ”), has since advised that it estimates the audit will be completed and the Annual Filings will be filed on or before December 31, 2026.   As previously announced, the delay is due to (i) the limited availability of the Auditor; and (ii) the additional time required to complete audit procedures relating to the Company's crypto-related investments, which are more complex than in prior years. The Auditor remains engaged, and the Company is working with the Auditor to complete the audit.

raw.title: Wesdome Expands High-Grade Zones at Eagle River, Highlighting Growth Potential near Existing Infrastructure
raw.text: High-grade growth potential laterally and at depth: Drilling in the western extension of the 800 Zone, one of the mineralized zones at Eagle River, intersected high-grade gold over significant widths, including 8.3 g/t gold over 10.6 metres, highlighting the potential to expand the known high-grade zone laterally. Previously released drilling also identified mineralization more than 200 metres below the current zone model, outlining a prospective corridor for further expansion at depth.

raw.title: Wesdome: The Q3 Production Miss Took Away The Premium, Not The Value
raw.text: Q3 production of 41,287 ounces was missed as Kiena lost 10 days to maintenance and blended in early Presqu'ile ore; Eagle River milled a record 79,820 tonnes. 2026 is expected below the 192,500-ounce midpoint, so Q4 needs about 49,600 ounces just to reach the guide floor. At C$28.00, the shares trade at 0.93x my US$21.57 risked NAV, against a 0.96x peer median: the fall removed a premium rather than opening a discount.

raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia, October 28, 2026 - TheNewswire – Westward Gold Inc. (CSE: WG, OTCQB: WGLIF, FSE: IM50) (“Westward” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce the appointment of Mr. Andrew Lee to the Company's Board of Directors, effective October 28, 2026. Mr. Lee will serve as Independent Director, replacing Mr. Allan Fabbro, who has acted in that role since June of 2023. Mr. Lee brings over 15 years of experience in mining finance, capital markets and strategy to Westward. He currently serves as Vice President, Finance at Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. (“Wheaton”), where he oversees corporate finance and treasury, and plays a key role in evaluating, structuring and executing streaming and royalty transactions and strategic investments. Prior to joining Wheaton in 2017, Mr. Lee held various positions at BHP Group in Singapore, focusing on global commodity markets and corporate strategy. He also serves as a director of Pacific Empire Minerals Corp. Mr. Lee holds a Master of Business Administration from Simon Fraser University and a Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Mathematics and Economics from Nanyang Technological University in Singapore.

(TSX: WELL) ("WELL"), a digital healthcare company focused on positively impacting health outcomes by leveraging technology to empower healthcare practitioners and their patients globally, today announced that the Commissioner of Competition has concluded the Competition Bureau's review of WELL's acquisition of a majority interest in HEALWELL and has issued a No Action Letter. The No Action Letter, issued on October 22, 2026, confirms that the Commissioner does not, at this time, intend to make an application under section 92 of the Competition Act in respect of WELL's acquisition of a controlling interest in HEALWELL completed on April 1, 2025, including HEALWELL's concurrent acquisition of Orion Health (the "Transaction").

raw.title: RecycLiCo and Alaska Energy Metals Collaborate to Test Proprietary Processing Methods on the Polymetallic Eureka Deposit, Nikolai Nickel Project, Alaska
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- RecycLiCo Battery Materials Inc. (“RecycLiCo”) (TSX.V: AMY | OTCQB: AMYZF | FSE: ID4), a critical mineral refining and lithium-ion battery upcycling company, and Alaska Energy Metals Corp. (“AEMC”) (TSX.V: AEMC | OTCQB: AKEMF | FRA: V7F) are pleased to announce the commencement of testing of metal concentrate samples derived from drill core from the 2023-2024 exploration campaigns at the polymetallic Eureka deposit, located at AEMC's Nikolai Nickel Project in Alaska. The work is being done at RecycLiCo's laboratory in Delta, BC, in accordance with a protocol prepared by RecycLiCo and approved by AEMC. Testing is in furtherance of the previously announced memorandum of understanding (“MOU”) between AEMC and RecycLiCo's U.S. subsidiary to assess the ways in which RecycLiCo's hydrometallurgical processing technology could be used in refining the output from the Eureka deposit, which contains seven U.S. Government-designated Critical Minerals, including nickel, cobalt, copper, chromium, platinum, palladium, and gold (along with the non-critical mainstay metal iron). Recently reported locked cycle flotation results have proven strong recoveries of metals reporting to a bulk nickel-copper concentrate. AEMC is exploring multiple avenues for hydrometallurgical testing to determine the optimum extraction technique to achieve the highest value from downstream processing of the bulk concentrate.

raw.title: RecycLiCo and Alaska Energy Metals Collaborate to Test Proprietary Processing Methods on the Polymetallic Eureka Deposit, Nikolai Nickel Project, Alaska
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- RecycLiCo Battery Materials Inc. (“RecycLiCo”) (TSX.V: AMY | OTCQB: AMYZF | FSE: ID4), a critical mineral refining and lithium-ion battery upcycling company, and Alaska Energy Metals Corp. (“AEMC”) (TSX.V: AEMC | OTCQB: AKEMF | FRA: V7F) are pleased to announce the commencement of testing of metal concentrate samples derived from drill core from the 2023-2024 exploration campaigns at the polymetallic Eureka deposit, located at AEMC's Nikolai Nickel Project in Alaska. The work is being done at RecycLiCo's laboratory in Delta, BC, in accordance with a protocol prepared by RecycLiCo and approved by AEMC. Testing is in furtherance of the previously announced memorandum of understanding (“MOU”) between AEMC and RecycLiCo's U.S. subsidiary to assess the ways in which RecycLiCo's hydrometallurgical processing technology could be used in refining the output from the Eureka deposit, which contains seven U.S. Government-designated Critical Minerals, including nickel, cobalt, copper, chromium, platinum, palladium, and gold (along with the non-critical mainstay metal iron). Recently reported locked cycle flotation results have proven strong recoveries of metals reporting to a bulk nickel-copper concentrate. AEMC is exploring multiple avenues for hydrometallurgical testing to determine the optimum extraction technique to achieve the highest value from downstream processing of the bulk concentrate.

raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 26, 2026) - Blue Star Gold Corp. (TSXV: BAU) (OTCQB: BAUFF) (FSE: 5WP0) ("Blue Star" or the "Company") announces final results from its 2026 Phase 2 Drill Program, including significant step-out intersections at the North Fold Nose deposit, follow-up drilling at North Nutaaq, and maiden drilling at Roma Main. The results highlight opportunities for resource expansion and new discoveries across several priority gold targets.

raw.title: Blackrock Silver Awards Civil Engineering Works to NewFields for Permit Designs on the Tonopah West Project
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 26, 2026) - Blackrock Silver Corp. (TSX: BRC) (OTCQX: BKRRF) (FSE: AHZ0) (the "Company" or "Blackrock") is pleased to announce that its wholly-owned Nevada subsidiary, Blackrock Gold Corp., has entered into a service agreement (the "Service Agreement") with NewFields Mining Design & Technical Services, LLC of Englewood, Colorado ("NewFields") to assist with the design requirements to complete permitting of an exploration decline, test mining and 50,000 tonnes (55,000 tons) bulk-sample extraction on the Company's Tonopah West project ("Tonopah West") located in Nye and Esmeralda Counties, Nevada, USA. NewFields will prepare construction-level designs for Tonopah West's Water Pollution Control Permit and Nevada Reclamation Permit, US Highway 95 tie in and access, and surface facilities needed to place silver and gold laden rock and associated waste rock material at surface as well as site facilities to support technical, construction and contractor needs.

raw.text: STOCKHOLM, Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BioArctic AB (publ) (Nasdaq Stockholm: BIOA B) today announced that Novartis Pharma AG has notified BioArctic that it has decided to terminate the Option, Collaboration and License Agreement entered into in August 2025 to explore a potential new treatment combining BioArctic's proprietary BrainTransporter™ technology with an undisclosed Novartis proprietary antibody. ("Silver Elephant"), as previously disclosed in news releases dated June 12, 2026 and September 14, 2026 (the "Transaction"). Pursuant to the asset purchase agreement (the "Asset Purchase Agreement") entered into among the Company, Silver Elephant and U.S. Fluorspar LLC (the "Vendor" or "Subsidiary"), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, Silver Elephant is required to pay to the Company an aggregate of US$1,255,000 in a series of cash payments as partial consideration for the purchase of the Robinson-Lasher Project, ending on or before September 1, 2029.

raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 28, 2026) - Eat Well Investment Group Inc. (CSE: EWG) (OTC Pink: EWGFF) (FSE: 6BC0) ("Eat Well" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that, further to its news release dated October 6, 2026 and a settlement and release agreement dated as of September 25, 2026 (the "Settlement Agreement"), the Company has closed the settlement (the "Settlement") of approximately $45 million of recorded obligations through the issuance of an aggregate of 7,339,218 Common Shares, comprised of: (a) 5,000,000 common shares of the Company ("Common Shares") issued at a deemed price of $0.10 per share (the "NPI Settlement Shares") to Kaha Foods LLC, the registered and beneficial holder of the Company's net profits interest shares, in settlement of the Company's recorded obligation to issue shares of $41,620,369 (the "Recorded NPI Obligation"); and (b) 2,339,218 Common Shares issued at a deemed price of $0.10 per share to certain current and former officers, directors and service providers of the Company (the "Settling Parties") who were each owed accrued compensation, fees or severance dating back to January 1, 2023, in settlement of $3,341,739 of accrued compensation, fees and related claims based on the balances recorded in the Company's accounts at June 30, 2026 (the "Compensation Debt"). As part of the settlement of the Compensation Debt, the Company has also agreed to pay the Settling Parties $100,252 in cash.

raw.title: Honey Badger Silver Announces Filing of NI 43-101 Technical Report for the PC Silver Mine Preliminary Economic Assessment
raw.text: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - October 29, 2026) - Honey Badger Silver Inc. (TSXV: TUF) (OTCQB: HBEIF) (FSE: 1QA) (Tradegate: 1QA) ("Honey Badger Silver" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has filed an independent technical report (the "Technical Report") prepared in accordance with National Instrument 43-101 - Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects ("NI 43-101"), supporting the previously announced Preliminary Economic Assessment (the "PEA") and updated Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE") for its 100%-owned PC Silver Mine (Prairie Creek) in the Northwest Territories, Canada. The Technical Report, entitled "Preliminary Economic Assessment - PC Silver Mine - Northwest Territories", with an effective date of June 21, 2026, and was prepared by JDS Energy & Mining Inc. The Technical Report is available under the Company's profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca and on the Company's website at www.honeybadgersilver.com.

raw.text: MONTREAL, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- HPQ Silicon Inc. (“HPQ” or the “Company”) (TSX-V: HPQ, OTCQB: HPQFF, FRA: O08), a technology company focused on innovation in advanced materials and critical process technologies, is pleased to announce that it has negotiated an agreement with a creditor of the Company to settle debts through the issuance of common shares of the Company, in lieu of cash payment, at a price of $0.13 per share.

raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia - TheNewswire -  October 29, 2026: Headwater Gold Inc. (CSE: HWG) (OTCQX: HWAUF) (the “Company” or “Headwater”) is pleased to announce it has acquired 100% interest in the Ollie Project (“Ollie” or the “Project”) through claim staking in Mineral County, Nevada. The Project is located within the Walker Lane gold belt, approximately 5 kilometres (“km”) northeast of Fortitude Gold Corporation's Isabella Pearl mine and 3 km east-northeast of Lahontan Gold Corp.'s Santa Fe project. raw.title: Li-FT Announces First Results from Summer Drill Program at the Adina-Galinée Lithium Project, Quebec
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Li-FT Power Ltd. (“LIFT” or the “Company”) (TSXV: LIFT) (ASX: LFT) (OTCQX: LIFFF) (Frankfurt: WS0) is pleased to announce assay results from the first 5 of 45 drill holes from the Adina-Galinée Lithium Project (“AGLP”) in Québec, Canada (Figure 1). The 45 holes comprise 39 holes totaling 11,420.5 metres completed as part of LIFT's 2026 summer drilling program, together with 6 previously unreleased historical drill holes from 2024 (1,983 metres), totalling 13,403.5 metres of drill core. Holes ALP-0001 to ALP-0005C from the 2026 drill campaign are presented in this release. The intercepts for drill holes ALP-0001 to ALP-0005C are presented in Table 1 and shown in figures 2, 3 & 4, with a highlight of 56 meters of 1.43 % Li 2 O intersected in drillhole ALP002.

raw.text: TORONTO, Ontario — October 29, 2026 - TheNewswire — LAURION Mineral Exploration Inc. (TSX-V: LME | OTC: LMEFF | FSE: 5YD) (“LAURION” or the “Company”) is pleased to report assay results from drill holes LBX26-113, LBX26-114A, LBX26-115, LBX26-116, LBX26-117 and LBX26-121, from its 2026 Phase 1 diamond drilling program at its 100%-owned Ishkōday Gold and Polymetallic Project (“Ishkōday Project”), located approximately 220 km northeast of Thunder Bay and 28 km northeast of Beardmore, Northwestern Ontario. Building on the drilling program to date, LAURION increased its planned Phase 1 drilling from 3,865 metres to 5,605 metres across 22 drill holes. The expanded program is being informed by SRK Consulting's independent structural gap analysis of the A-Zone, which identified five priority target areas where additional drilling may address key gaps in the existing drill database and further strengthen the geological understanding of the A-Zone. LAURION is using this framework, together with ongoing drill results, to prioritize near-term drilling as it continues to systematically advance its exploration of the A-Zone , with the objective of validating its geological interpretation and supporting the evaluation of a potential maiden Mineral Resource Estimate (“MRE”). Additional targets, sequencing and timing remain subject to, among other things, ongoing results and available financing.

raw.title: Critical Metals Corp. Acquisition of European Lithium Approved by Supreme Court of Western Australia
raw.text: NEW YORK, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Critical Metals Corp. (Nasdaq: CRML) (“Critical Metals Corp” or the “Company”), a leading critical minerals exploration and mining company, today announced that the Supreme Court of Western Australia (the “Court”) has approved the Company's proposed acquisition of European Lithium Limited (ASX: EUR, FRA: PF8, OTC: EULIF) (“European Lithium”). Under the proposed transaction, Critical Metals Corp would acquire 100% of the issued share capital of European Lithium and all of European Lithium's listed options by way of Court-approved schemes of arrangement under Part 5.1 of the Australian Corporations Act 2001 (Cth), comprising a scheme between European Lithium and its shareholders (the “Share Scheme”) and a scheme between European Lithium and the holders of its listed options (ASX: EUROC) (the “Option Scheme”, and together with the Share Scheme, the “Schemes”).

(“LIFT” or the “Company”) (TSXV: LIFT) (ASX: LFT) (OTCQX: LIFFF) (Frankfurt: WS0) is pleased to announce assay results from the first 5 of 45 drill holes from the Adina-Galinée Lithium Project (“AGLP”) in Québec, Canada (Figure 1). raw.text: October 27th, 2026 - TheNewswire – Rockport, Ontario – New Age Metals Inc. (“ NAM ” or the “ Company ”) (TSXV: NAM; OTCQB: NMTLF; FSE: P7J) is pleased to announce that it has entered into an option agreement with Benton Resources Inc. (TSXV:BEX) (“Benton”) dated June 24, 2026 as amended September 3, 2026 (the “Agreement”), whereby Benton has provided the Company a due diligence period until November 15, 2026 on the potential acquisition of a 100% interest in Benton's Abernethy Lake Gold Project, (to be renamed “Kenora Thunder Gold Project”) located approximately ten (10) kilometres from the City of Kenora in the Kenora Mining District, Northwestern Ontario. The Agreement provides the Company a due diligence period until November 15, 2026, to conduct investigations, consultations, meetings, review and assessments deemed necessary, including engaging with the applicable First Nations Chief and Council and other relevant Indigenous representatives, to determine whether sufficient support, access, approvals, permits and authorizations can be obtained to permit the continuation of the Company's option. Upon completion of the Company's review and prior to expiration of the due diligence period, the Company may deliver a notice to proceed (the “Notice”) with its option. A subsequent news release will be issued in the event the Company provides Benton with the Notice. The Notice would become the effective date of the Agreement. NAM is committed to working collaboratively with local First Nations to ensure responsible, sustainable exploration that respects community values and priorities.

raw.text: HIGHLIGHTS Novo has now received all regulatory and land holder approvals required to commence a ~2,700 m RC program at Tibooburra, NSW, with drilling at the Clone prospect currently anticipated to commence in early-November 2026.  Step out drilling at the Clone prospect will target a northern extension to open, shallowly plunging, high-grade gold mineralisation confirmed during Novo's 2025 drill campaign that reported results up to 12 m @ 5.90 g/t Au from 16 m, including 5 m @ 13.74 g/t Au from 23 m in TBR0001.1   Regional streams and targeted soils, mapping and rock chip sampling commenced at Tibooburra in September 2026, with results pending and a further program being undertaken in October 2026.

raw.title: Pinnacle Prepares Plans for Drilling and Field Work to Follow Up on Polymetallic Discoveries at El Potrero
raw.text: VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA, October 29, 2026 – TheNewswire - (TSXV: PINN, OTCQB: PSGCF, Frankfurt: P9J) – Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. (" Pinnacle " or the “ Company ") is pleased to announce that its geological team has put together a diamond drilling program to follow up on the silver-gold-lead-zinc mineralization discovered on the Maria Fernanda 2 (“MF2”) concession on the Potrero project in Durango, Mexico earlier this year (see Figures 1 and 2).  While permitting is underway on this drill program, detailed mapping and sampling will be conducted on the northern El Potrero claim block following up on the discovery of silver-rich veins with assays up to 1,159 g/t Ag (see Pinnacle news releases from March 17 and April 20, 2026 ) .   “The exciting discovery of high-grade gold-silver-lead-zinc mineralization earlier this year demonstrated the district scale potential of the Potrero Project ,” stated Robert Archer, Pinnacle's President & CEO.  “Having conducted extensive mapping and sampling on the MF2 concession, we now believe that this polymetallic mineralization is an extension of the Topia Mine system, only four kilometres to the southwest.  The polymetallic veins have a northeasterly trend, as at Topia, as opposed to the dominantly northwesterly trend of the gold-silver veins in the northern part of the Potrero property, and are believed to represent a completely different age of hydrothermal activity 1 .  The alteration, vein textures and elevation all point to the potential for the preservation of significant mineralization not far below surface at MF2.  The Phase I drill program will test this concept and, if successful, will lead to a larger drilling campaign of delineation drilling.  In addition, we look forward to following up on similar, silver-rich veins on the southern part of the Potrero block, roughly five kilometres from the MF2 mineralization.”

raw.title: Pinnacle Receives Permit for Surface Drilling Program at El Potrero and Provides Update on Other Permits for Production Restart
raw.text: VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA – TheNewswire - October 26, 2026 (TSXV: PINN, OTCQB: PSGCF, Frankfurt: P9J) – Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. (" Pinnacle " or the “ Company ") is pleased to announce that it has received a permit from the Secretaría del Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales ( SEMARNAT), Mexico's federal ministry responsible for environmental protection, natural resource management, and sustainable development , for a surface drilling program at the past-producing El Potrero gold-silver project in Durango, Mexico.  The permit covers 110 drill sites and is valid for two years.  At present Pinnacle is planning on a first-pass drill program contemplated to include 48 holes, for 5,540 metres.  Targets will include gaps around the historic mine workings that could not be reached by the current underground drilling program, the additional 1,100 metre strike extent of the Dos de Mayo vein system, the parallel El Capulín vein system and the Estrella vein (see Figure 1). Significantly, this permit is more than just a standard drill permit.  Due to the categorization of the area within which this part of the property lies as being classified as ‘Semi-warm, Sub-humid', the ‘NORMA 120' standard for drill permits does not apply.  Consequently, a full environmental permit, or Manifiesto Impacto Ambiental (MIA) was required.  In going through the protracted process of obtaining this permit, Pinnacle was required to provide substantively more background and baseline data than would normally be required for a drill permit, resulting in a longer approval time.  Having now done that however, the same data is being used to form the basis for the permits required for the mine, processing plant, tailings storage facility (TSF), powerline extension, water license, and auxiliary infrastructure, all of which are underway.

recentNews.title: Quarterhill Announces Repayment of Convertible Debentures

raw.title: Quarterhill Announces Repayment of Convertible Debentures
raw.text: TORONTO, Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Quarterhill Inc. ("Quarterhill" or the "Company") (TSX: QTRH) (OTCQX: QTRHF), a leading technology innovator providing next-generation, AI-driven Intelligent Transportation System ("ITS") solutions, today announced that it has repaid in full the CAD $57.5 million aggregate principal amount of its 6.0% convertible unsecured subordinated debentures (the "Convertible Debentures"), together with all accrued and unpaid interest thereon, on their maturity date of October 30, 2026. The Convertible Debentures will be delisted from the Toronto Stock Exchange, where they traded under the symbol QTRH.DB (CUSIP 747713AA3), effective at the close of markets on October 30, 2026.

raw.title: Saab and GA-ASI successfully flight test LoyalEye AEW capability on MQ-9B
raw.text: STOCKHOLM, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Saab and General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI) have successfully flight tested an unmanned airborne early warning (AEW) capability, integrating Saab's LoyalEye airborne early warning radar with the MQ-9B remotely piloted aircraft system.  Conducted during a flight at GA-ASI's Desert Horizon Flight Operations Facility in Southern California, the activity validated the performance of the integrated system, including its ability to detect, track, and classify airborne targets from an unmanned platform.

raw.title: CleanTech Provides Update on Robinson-Lasher Asset Sale Transaction
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 26, 2026) - CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp. (TSXV: CTV) (OTCQB: CTVFF) ("CleanTech" or the "Company") is pleased to provide an update with respect to the proposed sale of the Company's Robinson-Lasher zinc-germanium-gallium deposit (the "Robinson-Lasher Project") to Silver Elephant Mining Corp. ("Silver Elephant"), as previously disclosed in news releases dated June 12, 2026 and September 14, 2026 (the "Transaction"). Pursuant to the asset purchase agreement (the "Asset Purchase Agreement") entered into among the Company, Silver Elephant and U.S. Fluorspar LLC (the "Vendor" or "Subsidiary"), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, Silver Elephant is required to pay to the Company an aggregate of US$1,255,000 in a series of cash payments as partial consideration for the purchase of the Robinson-Lasher Project, ending on or before September 1, 2029.

raw.title: Silver Elephant Receives Approval to Proceed with Robinson-Lasher Asset Acquisition Transaction
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 26, 2026) - Silver Elephant Mining Corp. (TSX: ELEF) (OTCQB: SILEF) (FSE: 1P2)  ("Silver Elephant" or the "Company") is pleased to provide an update with respect to its proposed acquisition of the Robinson-Lasher zinc-germanium-gallium deposit (the "Robinson-Lasher Project") from CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp. ("CleanTech") (the "Transaction"), as previously disclosed in the news release dated June 12, 2026. Pursuant to the asset purchase agreement (the "Asset Purchase Agreement") entered into among Silver Elephant, CleanTech and U.S. Fluorspar LLC (the "Vendor"), a wholly owned subsidiary of CleanTech, Silver Elephant is required to, among other things, (i) pay to CleanTech an aggregate of US$1,255,000 as partial consideration for the purchase of the Robinson-Lasher Project, which will be paid in a series of cash payments ending on or before September 1, 2029, and of which the first cash payment of US$85,000 was made on September 17, 2026; (ii) issue 6,300,000 common shares of Silver Elephant at a deemed price of $0.13 per share to CleanTech (the "Share Consideration"), which Share Consideration was issued on October 23, 2026 following the receipt of approval in respect of the Transaction from the Toronto Stock Exchange by Silver Elephant and from the TSX Venture Exchange by CleanTech; and (iii) commit a minimum of US$2,000,000 in exploration expenditures on the Robinson-Lasher Project and prepare an independent National Instrument 43-101 technical report.

raw.title: Sirios Resources Inc. Announces Results of Shareholder Meeting
raw.text: Montréal, Québec--(Newsfile Corp. - October 30, 2026) - Sirios Resources Inc. (TSXV: SOI) (OTCQB: SIREF) (FSE: 377A) ("Sirios" or "Company") is pleased to announce the voting results for its annual general and special meeting of shareholders held earlier today at 900, boulevard De Maisonneuve Ouest, Suite 1800, Montréal, Québec, H3A 0A8 (the "Meeting"). Shareholders voted in favour of all matters brought before the Meeting and all resolutions were duly passed, including: (i) the election of each of the seven nominated directors, being Dominique Doucet, Jean-Félix Lepage, Colinda Parent, Guy Le Bel, Robert Ménard, Sean Roosen, and Laurence Farmer; (ii) the reappointment of Raymond Chabot Grant Thornton LLP as the independent auditor of the Company for the ensuing year and the authorization for the board of directors to fix its remuneration; (iii) a special resolution authorizing the change of name of the Company from "Sirios Resources Inc." to "Sirios Mining Inc." and, in French, "Minière Sirios Inc." ("Name Change"); (iv) a special resolution authorizing a share consolidation on the basis of one (1) post-consolidation common share for every fifteen (15) pre-consolidation common shares ("Consolidation"); and (v) the Company's new 10% "rolling" omnibus equity incentive plan ("Omnibus Plan"), which provides for the grant of options, share units, and deferred share units.
